scope_notes.label: Offshore West Australian versus coastal Leeuwin flow
scope_notes.summary: Modern West Australian Current means broad northward offshore flow, distinct from coastal southward Leeuwin. Andrews (1977) used the name for a cyclonic stream turning poleward: its reported 800 km trough extent and 100-200 km stream width remain historical source context, not admitted dimensions for this current or seasonal extrema. Whole-current axis, endpoints, width and annual ranges remain unresolved.

widths.boundary_rule: Issuer-reported greater-than geographic breadth. No velocity threshold, core edges, finite outer limit or section orientation extracted.
widths.extraction_method: Inequality transcribed from visually inspected original report prose. No contour digitization, current-axis diagnosis or conversion from the printed coordinate phrase.
widths.geographic_scope: Broad equatorward surface flow offshore of Leeuwin in the southeastern Indian Ocean; no reproducible cross-flow transect or paired endpoints supplied.
widths.layer: Source describes equatorward surface current as shallow; no fixed numerical depth layer supplied for the breadth.
widths.name: West Australian Current

original_regional_context.display_caption: West Australian Current: report describes offshore geographic breadth >1000 km. Not a measured 1000 km point, finite width interval, statistical bound or seasonal range.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Government synthesis, not a defined velocity section. The latitude 60 E coordinate phrase is inconsistent and is not converted to kilometres. Figure 6.15 is schematic; older 100-200 km cyclonic-stream width is separate naming context. No mapped band or seasonal playback inferred.

historical_stream_context.scope: Narrow cyclonic stream with poleward coastal turn, distinct source convention from broad offshore equatorward flow.

widths.range_interpretation: Reported offshore geographic breadth exceeds 1000 km in this synthesis. No representative width, finite upper end, statistical uncertainty, annual range or velocity-core boundaries extracted.
remaining_gates: Recover the underlying velocity-based breadth definition and compatible layer/time support.

widths.section_orientation: Offshore geographic breadth in government synthesis, not a defined transverse velocity section.

widths.time_convention: Undated geographic synthesis published 2008; publication year and adjacent summer inflow discussion do not date or season the breadth statement.
